Hymn 270: I'll Go Where You Want Me to Go
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Carrie E. Rounsefell
Lyricist/Text Author: Mary Brown
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 270 titled "I'll Go Where You Want Me to Go" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Carrie E. Rounsefell and the lyrics were written by Mary Brown.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
